name.description: Skill name (lowercase with hyphens, max 64 chars)

argument-hint.description: Hint shown to the user about expected arguments when invoking the skill

effort.description: Effort level when this skill is active (available levels depend on the model)

when_to_use.description: Extra trigger context appended to description in the skill listing (counts toward the 1,536-character cap)

arguments.description: Named positional arguments for $name substitution; space-separated string or YAML list

model.description: Recommended model ID or alias (Aug 2026 GA: claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5, claude-fable-5, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001; or alias opus|sonnet|haiku|fable)

allowed-tools.description: Tools pre-approved (no prompt) during the turn that invokes this skill; space/comma string or YAML list

disallowed-tools.description: Tools removed from Claude's pool while this skill is active; space/comma string or YAML list

disable-model-invocation.description: If true, the model cannot auto-invoke this skill; it must be called explicitly

user-invocable.description: If true, this skill is exposed as a user-invocable slash command

context.description: Set to 'fork' to run this skill in a forked subagent context

agent.description: Which subagent type to use when context: fork is set

background.description: With context: fork, set false to wait for the subagent's result in the turn instead of running it in the background (default true, v2.1.218+)

hooks.description: Hooks scoped to this skill's lifecycle (same shape as hooks.json)

paths.description: Glob patterns scoping where this skill applies

shell.description: Shell interpreter used if the skill runs shell code
